title: Fat Armored Warrior
description: A very large and obese man with a bare tattooed torso sits on a stone throne wearing black metal armor and a book on his head. His gloved hands rest on an open book on one side and an anvil on the other while papers and candles surround him in a fiery purple setting.
prompt: A very large obese man with a bare tattooed torso and nipples sits on a stone throne wearing black metal armor with purple text and a gold medallion. He has a book open on his head and his gloved hands rest on an open book to his left and a large anvil to his right. Burning papers with marks float around him in a fiery purple and orange cave-like setting with candles and more papers on the ground.
